title: VIXEN builds require a manual paired UNDERTOW_ROOT export
body: The documented build-wsl.sh invocation failed before compilation when UNDERTOW_ROOT was unset; the lane had to manually export the paired Undertow worktree for CMake configure and every target build. The VIXEN build facade should resolve or validate the paired Undertow provider automatically.

title: SpatialReuseShade cel math lacks a kernel-callable lowering seam
body: R677 requires touched shading math to use kernel callables where possible, but this existing SSBO GPU pass has no VIXEN KernelSystem/callable surface consumed by the pass. S2 therefore keeps the finite-difference footprint and hue blend shader-local; the facade should provide a declarative callable path for this pass.
